name: Rent Choice Youth
summary: NSW rent subsidy and support for 16 to 24 year olds at risk of homelessness who are studying, training or working.
key: Pays a portion of your rent for up to 36 months.
who: Aged 16 to 24 and homeless or at risk of homelessness.
Eligible for social housing and within its income limits; you may qualify if on low income or enrolled in studies.
Committed to education, training or employment and working with a support provider.
how: A support provider completes a Rent Choice referral form and sends it to your local Homes NSW office.
catches: Need is reviewed every three months.

evidence.quote: paying a portion of your rent for up to 36 months
